notes:
Summary: Enterprise legal search provider evaluating Redwood Private for RAG. Primary ask: high-scale embedding index + a cross-encoder reranker inside VPC with full audit trail.

CRM-style bullets: 
- Customer: litigation support platform, handles court filings + sealed docs.
- Index size target: ~150-250M documents (avg 1.2K tokens/doc).
- Embedding profile: 1536-dim, expect batch indexing throughput 50-150K docs/hr.
- Query throughput target: 5k QPS baseline, burst to 10k; 95p latency target for search+rerank <= 200ms.
- Cost target: want analysis for cost/query under different batching/quantization strategies (goal ~$0.002 - $0.01/query depending on reranker use).
- Security: cannot send unredacted PII out of customer VPC; KMS/HSM mandatory; 7+ years retention + immutable audit logs forwarded to Splunk.
- Regulatory: some customers require EU data residency for EU matters; want policy for per-tenant residency.
- Preferred model strategy: faiss/hnsw ANN for candidate generation (local), small cross-encoder re-ranker (customer provided or Redwood-hosted inside VPC).
- Fallbacks: want clear fallback routing to smaller model if reranker capacity constrained.

Customer quotes: "We cannot risk egress of sealed docs — everything must live in our VPC or on-prem box." — Head of Product

Sales notes: multi-stakeholder: Product (lead), Security (SaaS review), Infra (POC ops), Legal procurement. Expect procurement cycle 3-4 months post-POC if metrics hold.

use_case_summary: Tribunal wants a RAG-enabled enterprise search platform for legal discovery and compliance. Core flows: ingest large corpora (hundreds of millions of docs), compute and store embeddings in-tenant, run ANN candidate generation + cross-encoder reranking inside VPC/private deployment. Key metrics: 95p latency budget 150-200ms, steady throughput 5k QPS, burst to 10k. Cost sensitivity high; need Optimize recommendations (quant, batching, KV prefix caching) and per-query cost modelling. Data residency/retention: 7 years immutable audit logs, SIEM forwarding, strict KMS key control and rotation. Integration asks: SAML SSO, SCIM, Splunk/Datadog export, Jira for escalations.
